# 12 · The Stoneworks
Hammers and monuments: per-building payoffs, wonder-holding as an engine, windfalls
doubled. Wins by: The Most Marvels · The Builder · The Exposition — and the Opus is
itself a build.

**Tech:** Mining · Stonecraft (I); The Standing Stones (II); Construction · Engineering (III); Machinery (IV) — the hammer spine of the tree, all plain unlocks.

## Æra I
- Tech:
  - Mining — unlocks Mine, Clear Forest
  - Stonecraft — unlocks Monument, Palisade, Stonehenge, The Pyramids, Quarry, Consecration of the Bounds
- Orders:
  - Statute Labour — +1 production in every city for each 3 citizens living there.
  - Quarrymen's Guild — +5 production in every city holding Stone or Marble.
- Doctrines:
  - The Woodwrights (the chop doubled — 14's declared enemy)
- Religion:
  - The Standing Stones — Monuments supply +1 culture and +1 faith.
- Wonders:
  - The Pyramids — newly created workers gain +1 charge
- Deeds:
  - The First Marvel (recurring per age) — The first wonder finished in the world during an age.

## Æra II
- Orders:
  - Master Masons — Completing a building grants +5 culture.
  - The Masons' Lodge — Cities of 6 population or more put 10% more production behind buildings.
  - The Common Purse — Leftover production from a completed item is doubled.
  - Ore Tithes — +1 production on every hex carrying a strategic resource.
- Religion:
  - Guild of the Faithful — +10% production toward buildings in every city that follows.
- Great people: the Æra II engineers
- Wonders: the age's slate
- Deeds:
  - Three of the Age — Hold three wonders of the age the world stands in.
  - The Forge-City — Keep one city working to a hundred of production for ten turns together.

## Æra III
- Tech: **Artisanry** *(named — the hammer marquee)* — unlocks the Workshop: +2 production, +10% production in its city.
- Orders: 
  - The Wonder-Feasts *(user, named)* — cities gain +2 food while building a wonder · +10% production toward wonders.
- Doctrines:
  - Mountain Hold — +15% production in every city beside a mountain · +5 city defence there.
- Deeds:
  - The Most Marvels — At the close of the age, the empire holding the most wonders of it.
  - The Builder — Hold ten wonders at once.
  - The Exposition — A race. Needs six wonders held. The first empire to finish banks a great sum of culture.

## Æra IV
- Doctrines:
  - The Philosopher's Stone (deferred) — The Great Work costs −25% production. *(Distilleries removed by user ruling — First Distillation leaves the tree.)*
- The Opus: the build itself — this theme's whole IV
- Deeds: ▢ ________

## Gaps
The III marquee tech; nothing currently celebrates *holding* wonders but The Grand Tour.
